component.name: Timeler
component.summary: Atmospheric focus and Pomodoro timer with dynamic weather transitions

description.p: Timeler is an immersive focus and Pomodoro productivity timer with live dynamic weather transitions. As your focus session progresses, the atmosphere evolves in real time:

ul.li: Storm to Clear Sky: Rain and dark thunderclouds gradually clear into a peaceful, sunny summer sky.
Night to Dawn: A deep starry night smoothly transforms into a warm, golden mountain sunrise.
Customizable Pomodoro rounds with work intervals, short breaks, and long breaks.
Integrated Minimalist Task List to track your focus goals.
Modern glassmorphic interface inspired by macOS and GNOME aesthetics.

screenshot.caption: Timeler during an active focus session

description.p: Initial release of Timeler with Storm and Night-to-Dawn atmospheres, Pomodoro mode, and glassmorphic task list.
